rule: Predicted 1-sigma mid-transit uncertainty sqrt(sigma_T0^2 + (n sigma_P)^2) at +1, +6 and +12 months after the release reference time, from the release's one chosen ephemeris per planet. Priority (our rule, not ExoClock's): alert when the +1 month uncertainty exceeds 30 minutes or half the transit duration; high when the +6 month uncertainty does; medium when the +12 month uncertainty does; low otherwise; unranked when the ephemeris states no uncertainty. Rank 1 is the largest +12 month uncertainty.
